title: 2026년 산업기술국제협력(양자-스페인) 접수 공고

structured_excerpt.bsnsSumryCn:
산업통상부 공고 제 2026-165호(2026년 3월 9일)과 관련하여 「2026년 산업기술국제협력사업(양자-스페인)」 접수 일정을 다음과 같이 안내하오니 관심있는 기관은 관련 규정 및 절차에 따라 기한내 신청하여 주시기 바랍니다.


☞ 기업, 대학, 연구기관, 의료기관(산업기술혁신사업 공통 운영요령 제2조(용어의 정의))

- 주관연구개발기관 및 공동연구개발기관 中 국내기업은 접수마감일 현재 사업자등록증 및 법인등기부등본 기준으로 창업 1년 이상 경과하고, 한국산업기술진흥협회가 발급한 “기업부설연구소 인정서“를 보유하고 있는 국내사업자


☞ 양자공동펀딩형 R&D 지원

※ 자세한 지원내용 공고문 참조

### 첨부: (국문)_2026년도_한-스페인_국제공동기술개발사업_접수_안내문.md 제목 : 2026년 산업기술국제협력사업(양자-스페인) 접수 안내 |관련 : 산업통상부 공고 제 2026-165호| |---| |2026년 산업기술국제협력(양자-스페인) 접수 안내| |산업통상부 공고 제 2026-165호(2026년 3월 9일)과 관련하여 「2026년 산업기술국제협 력사업(양자-스페인)」 접수 일정을 다음과 같이 안내하오니 관심있는 기관은 관련 규 정 및 절차에 따라 기한내 신청하여 주시기 바랍니다.| |---| |2026년 9월 21일 한국산업기술진흥원| |Ⅰ| |---| |사업개요| |---| # 1. 사업 목적 ○ 국내 산·학·연과 해외 우수 R&D 기관과의 국제공동연구개발 지원하여 해외 기술 자원의 효과적인 활용, 첨단기술 확보 및 해외시장 진출을 통한 산업경쟁력 고도화 # 2. 사업내용 ○ (양자 공동펀딩 R&D) 양국 정부간 합의한 협력국가의 기관과 컨소시엄을 구성 하고 해당국과 공동 승인한 과제를 대상으로 자국 기관에 자금 지원 # 3. 사업비 지원 규모, 기간 및 신청자격 |대상국가|지원규모|지원기간|국내주관기관자격|국내공동기관자격|국내 접수 기한| |---|---|---|---|---|---| |스페인|10억원 이내/년|3년 이내|중소·중견|제한없음|~‘27. 1. 28.(목) 16:00까지| - 지원 규모 및 예산은 변동될 수 있음 (1차년도는 사업기간에 따라 정부출연금 조정) - 지원관련 상세내용은 첨부된 「2026년 산업기술국제협력사업 공고문(제2026-165호, ‘26.3.9.) 참조 # 4. 사업 추진체계 ○ 양자 공동펀딩 R&D (정부간 합의기반 국가) 상대국 정부 협력 산업통상부 사업추진방향 설정 사업추진방향 설정 상대국 전문기관* 협력 한국산업기술진흥원 사업기획 및 평가 사업기획 및 평가 자금 지원 자금 지원 해외 수행기관 국내 연구개발기관 개발과제 수행 ←공동R&D 수행→ 개발과제 수행 * 상대국 전문기관: 스페인(CDTI) # 5. 지원분야 ## ○ 첨단소재 |II| |---| |세부 지원절차| |---| - 1. 지원절차 ### ○ 국내기관은 KIAT에, 해외기관은 해외 전문기관에 동시에 과제를 신청하여야 접수가 인정되며, 한 쪽 기관에만 신청할 경우 사전 제외 #### 【한-스페인 국제공동R&D 추진 절차】 |사업공고| |---| |연구개발계획서 접수| |---| |연구개발계획서 평가| |---| |지원대상과제 확정| |---| |협약체결 및 사업수행| |---| (한국) www.kiat.or.kr, www.k-pass.kr (스페인) CDTI 홈페이지 (한국) 한국산업기술진흥원 www.k-pass.kr (스페인) CDTI 홈페이지 양국 공통 접수된 과제만 평가 (양국 전문기관간 과제정보 공유) 양국 전문기관 각자 평가 실시 (각국의 평가방식 적용) 개별국 평가결과에 따라 양국 정부간 협의를 통해 지원 확정 각국 전문기관과 연구개발기관간 각각 협약체결 및 자금지원 ##### * 스페인측 지원절차는 상이할 수 있으므로 영문 공고문을 반드시 참고하여 양 국가간 지원절차를 준수하여야 함 (양측 접수 마감일 등을 반드시 확인 후 한국과 스페인 양쪽 모두 접수 요망) # 2. 지원일정 |국내 일정| | | | |---|---|---|---| |접수

| |~‘27. 1. 28.(목) 16:00까지 (한국표준시간)|‘27년 3월~4월|‘27년 4월~5월|’27년 8월| ※ 상기일정은 전문기관 및 상대국의 사정에 따라 변경될 수 있음 # 3. 문의처 - 한국산업기술진흥원 국제협력사업실 우지현 연구원 - 02-6009-3767, jeehyun.woo@kiat.or.kr - CDTI(스페인 전문기관) Merced Perez (공고관련) - +34-91-581-5607, merced.perez@cdti.es - CDTI(스페인 전문기관) Jordi Espluga (CDTI 한국지사) - 070-4117-0888, Jordi.espluga@cdti.es - 온라인 접수(K-PASS) 관련 문의처: - 한국산업기술진흥원 통합유지보수(02-6009-4319~4321) --- ### 첨부: (영문)_2026년도_한-스페인_국제공동기술개발사업_접수_안내문.md |4th KOREAN-SPANISH JOINT CALL FOR STRATEGIC R&D&I PROJECTS 2026 - 2027| |---| KIAT-CDTI CALL FOR PROPOSALS UNDER THE KOREA SPAIN STRATEGIC PROGRAMME (KSSP) Korea Institute for Advancement of Technology (KIAT) and the Centre for the Development of Technology and Innovation E.P.E. (CDTI) have been designated as funding agencies to manage a new joint top-down R&D Bilateral Programme, the Korea Spain Strategic Programme (KSSP), to select and fund singular projects in mutually agreed topics. 1 This call for proposals under the KSSP aims to launch ambitious strategic joint R&D projects of a high international standard between Korean and Spanish organizations. The selected projects will be funded by KIAT in Korea and CDTI in Spain. CALL GUIDELINES: 1) IMPLEMENTING AGENCIES The Korea Institute for Advancement of Technology (KIAT) under Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources of the Republic of Korea (MOTIR) Government of Republic of Korea and the Centre for the Development of Technology and Innovation E.P.E. (CDTI), under the Ministry of Science, Innovation and Universities (MICIU) of the Government of the Kingdom of Spain, are the nodal implementing agencies from the Korean and Spanish sides, respectively. KIAT is a public R&D funding and promoting agency under MOTIR. The mission is to realize a technologically leading nation through related industrial technology policy, promoting innovation, and infrastructure strengthening in Korea. CDTI is a public entity under MICIU, which fosters the technological development and innovation of Spanish Companies. KIAT and CDTI have allocated to this Joint Call the Korean Government and CDTI budget respectively. Its contribution to partners in singular projects will be in the form of grants: - KIAT, with a maximum of 1,000 million won a year per project. - CDTI, with a maximum of 2 million euro per project. ### 2) THEMATIC AREAS This Call for proposals is open to collaborative R&D projects in the following areas/sectors: Advanced materials ### 3) TYPE OF PROJECTS KSSP is aimed at encouraging collaborative cross-border innovative civil joint R&D projects between Korean and Spanish industrial partners, consisting in the development or substantial improvement of new products, processes, or services. None of the countries´ budget (namely the budget of its entities participating in the proposal) can have more than 60% of the global budget of the project. Duration of projects: from 12 months up to 36 months Starting date of projects: on August 1, 2027. ## 2 ### 4) WHO CAN APPLY? KSSP projects will be developed by consortia composed of Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) and Middle-standing Enterprises (MEs) and Large Enterprises and Universities or Research Centers in Korea, and SMEs and Large companies in Spain. Each consortium leaders are a large or medium size company from Spain and a SME or ME from Korea. Consortia are composed by a minimum of at least one SME or ME in Korea and at least two independent industrial partners (SMEs and large companies) in Spain. Spanish part of the consortia shall include at least two companies with a minimum SME budget contribution of 10% to the overall Spanish part budget. Participation of research institutes/universities and other organizations are welcome as subcontractors. The Korean side shall include at least one SME or ME as consortium leader. ### 5) TIMETABLE - Launch of Joint Call for Proposals: Sep 21, 2026 - Deadline for Submission (International): January 28, 2027 - Eligibility feedback to applicants: February 18, 2027 - Label concession: May 17, 2027 - Deadline for Submission of Signed Consortium Agreement: June 28, 2027 ### 6) HOW TO APPLY? ### Common International procedure: Project proposals (KSSP Application form) must be submitted to CDTI and to KIAT, by January 28, 2027 in order to consider the eligibility. Unilaterally submitted proposals shall not be considered. Applications will be submitted to the online process system to both funding agencies: - In Korea, https://www.k-pass.kr - In Spain, https://sede.cdti.gob.es ## 3 ### Documents: ▪ Korean and Spanish co-applicants must elaborate a single project proposal application (Annex 1 – KSSP Application Form). The KSSP Application Form must emphasize how the proposed collaboration adds value, main technology highlights and innovations, activities to be developed by the Parties involved underlining the collaborative work being carried out on each side, their expertise, etc. Please note that this Application Form must be sealed and signed by all coapplicants, expressly indicating name and designation of the authorized signatory in the organization. Any other relevant information not expressly mentioned on the form and that the applicants consider relevant may be included as Annexes. ### Additional specific documents required by KIAT In addition to the common documents, it is necessary to submit Korean documents required through MOTIR and KIAT announcements: the Main Korean partners should submit additional documents to https://www.k-pass.kr with the common documents until call deadline. ### Additional specific documents required by CDTI The Funding Application in Spanish required by CDTI: all Spanish partners, individually, must submit the funding application and other required documents through the electronic platform at https://sede.cdti.gob.es . Funding application must be submitted after receiving the communication of label concession until June 28, 2027. The complete details of the Joint Call will be available on KIAT’s and CDTI’s websites: https://www.kiat.or.kr and http://www.cdti.es Applicants are recommended to contact the nodal representatives at their national funding organizations whose contact details are given below: Korean side (KIAT) Ms. Jeehyun WOO (Korea) Phone: +82 2 6009 3767. E-mail: jeehyun.woo@kiat.or.kr Spanish side (CDTI) Ms. Merced Pérez (Spain) Phone: +34 91 581 0489. E-mail: merced.perez@cdti.es Mr. Jordi Espluga (Korea) Phone: +82 (0)70 4117 0888. E-mail: jordi.espluga@cdti.es ## 4 ### 7) ELIGIBLE COSTS AND FUNDING The project must clearly specify the costs of each of the activities pertaining to the project and specify the costs to be respectively borne by the Spanish and Korean partners. The cost of the Korean and Spanish partners must be eligible under the laws applying to each country and under internal regulations of CDTI and KIAT, respectively. The funding conditions of the Korean participants are set in Won and the Spanish in Euro. Budgets must be expressed in the local currency of each applicant (Won and Euro). All figures and budgetary conditions in this Call refer to the value of both currencies on the date of the launch of the Call. It is mandatory to include expenses for the project execution during 2027. Funding related specifics for each country are: - Concerning Spain, according to Spanish regulations which shall be defined in the Spanish Call. Eligible costs for each of the Spanish participants must be linked to Industrial Research or Experimental Development tasks. The aid shall have incentive effect, i.e., the project can only start after the date of submission of the funding request to CDTI. It is mandatory that each Spanish participant requests funding to CDTI. The minimum eligible budget amount for each Spanish partner is 175,000 €. The overall budget of the Spanish participants in a project will be between 2.5 million euro and 6 million euro. - Concerning Korea, according to Korean Regulations which are defined in Korean Call Text. Korean companies should be in operation for at least one year since their establishment, and the companies are required to have 'corporate R&D center certification’ issued by the KOITA (Korea Industrial Technology Association). Project funding consists of government contributions and civilian dues (cash and inkind). The amount of government contributions will vary depending on the type of executing organizations and project. The funding ratio is as follows: up to 67% for SMEs, 50% for MEs, 33% for large companies, and 100% for universities and research organizations. ## 5 ### 8) REVIEW PROCESS AND EVALUATION The KIAT-CDTI Partnership Steering Committee, integrated by representatives of the parties as defined in the Memorandum of Understanding signed by KIAT and CDTI on 24th of June 2022, shall coordinate this call and shall manage the review and selection process. A company can only participate in one consortium, in other words, cannot participate in two or more KSSP proposals of the same call. All eligible proposals will be peer reviewed by a panel of independent experts and scored after the assessment according to international practices. Only the proposals with a score exceeding the pre-defined threshold in the total score will be in the Ranking List submitted to the KIAT-CDTI Partnership Steering Committee for endorsement. A minimum of 2 projects from this Ranking List will be endorsed by the Steering Committee. The total number of projects selected will depend on the budget allocated by KIAT and CDTI for KSSP Call 2026-2027 and the size of the selected projects. The endorsed proposals will receive the KSSP Approval Letter (Label concession) that confirms the availability of funding. The allocation of national funding to selected applications shall follow the score of the Ranking List. Participants receiving the KSSP Approval Letter are requested to contact each national funding agency, CDTI or KIAT. #### 9) EVALUATION CRITERIA The evaluation criteria are the following: • Innovation and R&D (50 points), relates to requirement that the project must involve research and development and yield a specific advance. Aspects to be considered include: - Degree of Innovation - Level of technical challenge o Technical achievability - Quality and efficiency of the R&D implementation (25 points), relates to the partnership, participants and project structure. It deals with the project plan and the capabilities of the participants in relation to their tasks in the project. Aspects to be considered include: - Quality of the consortium - Added value through co-operation - Project management and planning - Reasonable cost structure - Market and Commercialization (25 points), relates to the market targeted, the competitive advantages for the participants involved and the impact of the project results. Aspects to be considered include: - Market size, access, and risk - Competitive advantage - Clear and realistic commercialization plans - Economic, Environmental, and Societal impact ## 6 The threshold for the total score of the proposal is 70/100. Projects that fail to score above 70 points from either country will be excluded from funding. ### 10) FUNDING DECISIONS After receiving Steering Committee’s endorsement decision, KIAT and CDTI will make their funding decisions according to their normal procedures and rules and on a non-exchange of funds basis. CDTI and KIAT will inform the beneficiaries about the funding decisions. ### 11) REPORTING AND PROJECT OUTPUT Funding granted by KIAT and CDTI will be governed by the general terms, calls and conditions of each funding agency, respectively. Both parties will carry out an international follow-up until the completion of the projects considering the progress reports of the KSSP Project prepared by project participants. Both parties will inform the counterpart about the success or failure of the international cooperation. If required, each participant should submit financial and technical reports to their national funding organisations, according to national regulations. The progress and final results of each individual contract/grant will be monitored by the respective national funding organisations under their own regulation

# 딥 분석 대상 프로필 — 허파랑 팀 (2026-04-24)

이 파일은 `pending_deep_analysis.json` 처리 시 각 Sonnet 서브에이전트에게
평가 기준으로 전달된다. 프로필이 바뀌면 이 파일만 고치고 `deep_analysis/*.json`을
재생성하면 된다.

## 트랙 1 — 본인 (기창업 · sinhon.life · 엑스컴)

**제품**
- 서비스: sinhon.life (B2C 신혼부부 플랫폼, 2025~ 운영)
- 스택: Next.js 14 App Router · AWS Amplify · Pinecone RAG · Anthropic API
- 배포: Amplify ap-northeast-2, main push 시 자동 배포
- 강점: RAG 파이프라인 프로덕션 운영, AI 에이전트 구현, 부부 프로필 SSOT 설계

**법인**
- (주)엑스컴 · 법인번호 715-81-03544
- 개업: 2025-10-17 (오늘 기준 약 6개월차)
- 소재지: 인천광역시 부평구 U1센터
- 업종: SW개발 + 미디어콘텐츠 10업종 (주업 SW)

**당사자성 서사** (E-01~E-30 evidence pack)
- 결혼 → 인천 이주 → 1억 검색 → 정책 언어의 벽 → 창업
- 3축 플라이휠(부부 데이터 / 신혼 커머스 / 정책 매칭)
- 글로벌 3단계 (국내 → 한인 → K-웨딩 인바운드)

**레퍼런스**
- sinhon.life (본인 프로덕트)
- 유튜브 "허파랑" 채널 (콘텐츠/크리에이터 트랙)

**강점 키워드**
- B2C 프로덕트 운영·UX·퍼포먼스 마케팅
- AI/RAG 에이전트 구현
- 신혼·결혼·이주·신혼부부 당사자성
- SW개발(주업) + 미디어콘텐츠

**약점 키워드 (도메인 레퍼런스 0)**
- 금융·증권·보험·법무·헬스케어
- 제조·하드웨어·로봇·바이오
- B2G·공공조달
- 6개월차 신생법인 → 매출 실적 미약

## 트랙 2 — 와이프 (예비창업)

- 신분: 예비창업자
- 지역 우선: **경기 → 대구경북(백업)**
- 이중지원 전략: 부부·가족·공동창업자 이중지원 자동 감지·차별화·중복방지 (v2.1)
- BM 분리 필수: 본인 sinhon.life와 주제·규모·시장 겹치지 않게 설계

|---|---|---|---|
| 모두의 창업 로컬트랙(대구경북) | 2026-05-15 | 와이프 | 🟢 1순위 |

## 판정 기준 (각 공고에 대해)

1. **직접 매칭**: sinhon.life(B2C·신혼·AI) 또는 엑스컴(SW·미디어콘텐츠)이 공고 주제와 직접 맞는가?
2. **도메인 레퍼런스 요구**: 공고가 요구하는 도메인 포트폴리오를 우리가 가졌는가?
3. **ROI**: 합격률 × 직접 혜택(상금·PoC금·바우처) vs 투입 시간(서류+발표+수행)이 양수인가?
4. **기회비용**: 같은 기간 ROI 더 높은 대안(춘기 풀 3건, 수시 공고)이 있는가?
5. **사이클**: 지금이 주요 사이클 공백기(4~5·7~9월)인가? 공백기라면 수시·특화·지자체 후발 공고에만 자원 배분.

## 자동 NO-GO 조건 (하나라도 해당하면 NO-GO)

- sinhon.life와 공고 주제가 완전 무관 + 금융·제조 도메인 레퍼런스 요구
- 기댓값(합격률 × 금전 혜택) < 100만원이면서 투입 ≥ 100시간
- 같은 기간 🟢 트랙 공고가 2개 이상 열려 있고 본 공고가 🟡 이하
- "교육만 수료하면 끝" 성격이거나 "네트워킹·홍보만" (직접자금 0, 매칭금 0)

## 자동 CONDITIONAL-GO 조건

- 도메인 fit이 🟡(기술만 인접, 도메인 레퍼런스 없음)
- 합격 시 기댓값은 있으나 도메인 레퍼런스 확보가 선결 과제
- → "프로토타입 2주 내 완성 가능" + "현업 컨택" AND 조건 명시

## 자동 GO 조건 (하나라도 해당하면 GO 후보)

- sinhon.life 또는 엑스컴과 직접 매칭 (🟢)
- 와이프 트랙에 예비창업·지역(경기·대구경북) 적격
- 직접 자금 3천만원 이상 + 투입 시간 150h 이하

## 출력 스키마 엄격 준수

각 공고 분석은 `samples/177176.json`의 스키마를 **정확히** 따른다.
특히:
- `verdict.decision` ∈ {GO, NO-GO, CONDITIONAL-GO}
- `verdict.confidence` ∈ {high, medium, low}
- `probability.final` ∈ [0.03, 0.30]
- `sections.alternatives.items[]`는 이 파일의 "2026 춘기 공고 풀"과 현재 유효 공고 기준으로 선택
- JSON만 출력. 마크다운 코드블록·설명 없음.
